description: Booking saga / Temporal worker visibility. GF13 (SPEC-W34): the opendesk_saga_* panels were removed — no service ever emitted those metrics.

panels.title: Saga metrics are planned, not yet emitted

options.content:
## No saga metrics exist yet (honest placeholder — GF13 / SPEC-W34)

This dashboard previously showed six panels; **five referenced `opendesk_saga_*`
metrics that nothing in this repository has ever emitted** (verified by grep
across `services/`): booking-service and notification-worker (Go) currently
expose **no Prometheus `/metrics` endpoint at all** — only `/healthz`.

The panels were removed rather than left dead.

**Planned instrumentation** (when the Go services land Prometheus exporters):

- `opendesk_saga_duration_seconds` (histogram, by workflow)
- `opendesk_saga_total` (counter, by outcome: completed/compensated/failed)
- `opendesk_saga_activity_duration_seconds` (histogram, by activity step)

**Until then, saga-adjacent live signals live elsewhere:**

- *Platform overview* dashboard: analytics consumer lag, flush error rate
- CRM sync health: `crm_sync_counter`, `crm_sync_twenty_call_duration_seconds`
  (re-add panels here once this dashboard has real saga panels to sit beside)
- Temporal itself: scrape the Temporal server's own metrics endpoint when the
  compose Temporal service grows a prometheus listen config.
